spec.rationale: Prospective calibration cohort ineligible: registered_at is after observable_after (2026-09-25) even though FY2026 TTM is not yet in admitted sec_companyfacts or DOWNLOAD_MANIFEST. Types the owner-earnings leg of the operating_business_and_net_assets prose falsifier. The low-case owner_earnings_reinvestment_dcf proof locks the owner_earnings fact at 13,288 USD millions (FY2025 operating cash flow tag on accession 0000858877-25-000111). Resolution uses normalized_owner_earnings_ttm_m_v2 (TTM operating cash flow minus absolute TTM capital expenditures via sec_companyfacts_ttm). If trailing-twelve-month normalized owner earnings at FY2026 year-end (2026-07-26) resolve below that low-case anchor, distributable owner cash has fallen below the low-case bridge and the bounded per-share range should compress toward the low case (31.89 USD per share vs 58.05 base). Incremental after-tax ROIC and reinvestment-rate legs remain judgment inputs without a resolvable SEC metric and are not typed here. Historical adapter replay on Q3 FY2025 (measurement end 2025-04-26) resolved 12,803 USD millions via sec_companyfacts_ttm. Target FY2026 TTM is not observable at registration (2026-10-13); FY2026 year-end 10-K is not yet in CSCO/investor-documents/DOWNLOAD_MANIFEST.json (admitted manifest sha256 1d918d139ef51ff4e91d7e48f2819e414127313555928ecdfdf8117e280a665d). Component fingerprint unchanged from prior author pass; only the work-item input digest rebinding (0d834475ae5ccf454ae6f1aba0cab254903ad347) — forecast thresholds and probability not adapted to post-cutoff evidence. A 34% fire probability weights interim cash softness against Cisco fiscal Q4 seasonality and historically sticky enterprise networking cash flow.
